name: devkit
description: Build, install, launch, profile and release apps and games on remote devkit hosts (macOS now; Windows and Linux later) through the devkit MCP server.

devkit_url.title: Devkit address
devkit_url.description: Address of the devkit server, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:7420 or a Tailscale name. Shown in the devkit web UI under Settings.

devkit_token.title: Access token
devkit_token.description: An Operator token from the devkit web UI (Settings → Access tokens). Stored in Claude Code's credential store.
